verses.text: For di first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, so that di word of di Lord by di mouth of Jeremiah go happen, di Lord wake up di spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia, so that e send word through all im kingdom, and e write am too, say,
“Dis na wetin Cyrus, king of Persia, talk: Di Lord, di God of heaven, don give me all di kingdoms of di earth, and e don command me to build house for am for Jerusalem, wey dey Judah.
Anybody among una wey belong to im people, make im God dey with am, and make e go up to Jerusalem, wey dey Judah, and build di house of di Lord, di God of Israel, e be God, wey dey Jerusalem.
Anybody wey remain, for any place where e dey stay, make di people of di place help am with silver, gold, goods and animals, apart from di freewill offering for God house wey dey Jerusalem.”
Den di heads of di papa houses of Judah and Benjamin, di priests and di Levites, all wey God don wake dem spirit to go up and build di Lord house wey dey Jerusalem, stand up.
All dem wey dey round dem strengthen dem hands with silver vessels, gold, goods, animals and precious things, apart from all wey dem give willingly.
King Cyrus bring out di vessels of di Lord house too, wey Nebuchadnezzar don carry from Jerusalem and put for di house of im gods.
Cyrus, king of Persia, bring dem out by di hand of Mithredath di treasurer, and e count dem give Sheshbazzar, di prince of Judah.
Dis na di number: 30 gold plates, 1,000 silver plates, 29 knives,
30 gold bowls, 410 silver bowls of second kind, and 1,000 other vessels.
All di gold and silver vessels na 5,400. Sheshbazzar carry all dis come up when dem bring di prisoners up from Babylon go Jerusalem.
Now dis na di people of di province wey go up from di prisoner land, dem wey Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, don carry go Babylon, and wey return go Jerusalem and Judah, each one to im city.
Dem come with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum and Baanah. Di number of di men of di people of Israel:
Di pikin dem of Parosh, 2,172.
Di pikin dem of Shephatiah, 372.
Di pikin dem of Arah, 775.
Di pikin dem of Pahath Moab, of di pikin dem of Jeshua and Joab, 2,812.
Di pikin dem of Elam, 1,254.
Di pikin dem of Zattu, 945.
Di pikin dem of Zaccai, 760.
Di pikin dem of Bani, 642.
Di pikin dem of Bebai, 623.
Di pikin dem of Azgad, 1,222.
Di pikin dem of Adonikam, 666.
Di pikin dem of Bigvai, 2,056.
Di pikin dem of Adin, 454.
Di pikin dem of Ater, of Hezekiah, 98.
Di pikin dem of Bezai, 323.
Di pikin dem of Jorah, 112.
Di pikin dem of Hashum, 223.
Di pikin dem of Gibbar, 95.
Di pikin dem of Bethlehem, 123.
Di men of Netophah, 56.
Di men of Anathoth, 128.
Di pikin dem of Azmaveth, 42.
Di pikin dem of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah and Beeroth, 743.
Di pikin dem of Ramah and Geba, 621.
Di men of Michmas, 122.
Di men of Bethel and Ai, 223.
Di pikin dem of Nebo, 52.
Di pikin dem of Magbish, 156.
Di pikin dem of di other Elam, 1,254.
Di pikin dem of Harim, 320.
Di pikin dem of Lod, Hadid and Ono, 725.
Di pikin dem of Jericho, 345.
Di pikin dem of Senaah, 3,630.
Di priests: di pikin dem of Jedaiah, of di house of Jeshua, 973.
Di pikin dem of Immer, 1,052.
Di pikin dem of Pashhur, 1,247.
Di pikin dem of Harim, 1,017.
Di Levites: di pikin dem of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of di pikin dem of Hodaviah, 74.
Di singers: di pikin dem of Asaph, 128.
Di pikin dem of di gatekeepers: di pikin dem of Shallum, di pikin dem of Ater, di pikin dem of Talmon, di pikin dem of Akkub, di pikin dem of Hatita and di pikin dem of Shobai, all together 139.
Di temple servants: di pikin dem of Ziha, di pikin dem of Hasupha, di pikin dem of Tabbaoth,
di pikin dem of Keros, di pikin dem of Siaha, di pikin dem of Padon,
di pikin dem of Lebanah, di pikin dem of Hagabah, di pikin dem of Akkub,
di pikin dem of Hagab, di pikin dem of Shamlai, di pikin dem of Hanan,
di pikin dem of Giddel, di pikin dem of Gahar, di pikin dem of Reaiah,
di pikin dem of Rezin, di pikin dem of Nekoda, di pikin dem of Gazzam,
di pikin dem of Uzza, di pikin dem of Paseah, di pikin dem of Besai,
di pikin dem of Asnah, di pikin dem of Meunim, di pikin dem of Nephisim,
di pikin dem of Bakbuk, di pikin dem of Hakupha, di pikin dem of Harhur,
di pikin dem of Bazluth, di pikin dem of Mehida, di pikin dem of Harsha,
di pikin dem of Barkos, di pikin dem of Sisera, di pikin dem of Temah,
di pikin dem of Neziah and di pikin dem of Hatipha.
Di pikin dem of Solomon servants: di pikin dem of Sotai, di pikin dem of Hassophereth, di pikin dem of Peruda,
di pikin dem of Jaalah, di pikin dem of Darkon, di pikin dem of Giddel,
di pikin dem of Shephatiah, di pikin dem of Hattil, di pikin dem of Pochereth Hazzebaim and di pikin dem of Ami.
All di temple servants and di pikin dem of Solomon servants na 392.
Dem na di ones wey go up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan and Immer, but dem no fit show dem papa houses and dem family, if dem be of Israel:
di pikin dem of Delaiah, di pikin dem of Tobiah and di pikin dem of Nekoda, 652.
Of di pikin dem of di priests: di pikin dem of Hobaiah, di pikin dem of Hakkoz and di pikin dem of Barzillai, wey marry one of di daughters of Barzillai di Gileadite and dem call am by dia name.
Dem look for dem family record among dem wey dem register, but dem no find am, so dem take dem as unclean and remove dem from di priesthood.
Di governor talk to dem say make dem no eat di most holy things until priest stand up with Urim and Thummim.
Di whole gathering together na 42,360,
apart from dem male servants and dem female servants, wey be 7,337. Dem get 200 singing men and singing women.
Dem horses na 736, dem mules 245,
dem camels 435 and dem donkeys 6,720.
Some of di heads of di papa houses, when dem reach di Lord house wey dey Jerusalem, give willingly for God house to set am up for im place.
Dem give to di treasury of di work according to dem power: 61,000 gold coins, 5,000 pounds of silver and 100 priests clothes.
So di priests, di Levites, some of di people, di singers, di gatekeepers and di temple servants stay for dem cities, and all Israel for dem cities.
When di seventh month reach, and di pikin dem of Israel dey for dem cities, di people gather together like one man for Jerusalem.

Den Jeshua, Jozadak pikin, with im brothers di priests, and Zerubbabel, Shealtiel pikin, with im brothers, stand up and build di altar of di God of Israel to offer burnt offerings on am, as dem write am for di law of Moses, di man of God.
Dem set di altar on im base, because fear dey on dem because of di peoples of di lands. Dem offer burnt offerings on am to di Lord, burnt offerings for morning and evening.
Dem keep di Feast of Tents, as dem write am, and dem offer di daily burnt offerings by number, according to di rule, as di duty of every day need,
and after dat di continual burnt offering, di offerings of di new moons and of all di set feasts of di Lord wey dem don make holy, and of everybody wey give freewill offering to di Lord.
From di first day of di seventh month dem begin to offer burnt offerings to di Lord, but dem never lay di foundation of di Lord temple.

Dem give money to di stone workers and to di carpenters, and food, drink and oil to di people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar wood from Lebanon go di sea, to Joppa, according to wetin Cyrus, king of Persia, permit dem.

For di second year after dem come to God house for Jerusalem, for di second month, Zerubbabel, Shealtiel pikin, Jeshua, Jozadak pikin, and di rest of dem brothers di priests and di Levites, and all wey don come from di prisoner land go Jerusalem, begin di work. Dem appoint di Levites, from 20 years old go up, to oversee di work of di Lord house.

Den Jeshua stand with im sons and im brothers, Kadmiel and im sons, di sons of Judah, together, to oversee dem wey dey do di work for God house, with di sons of Henadad, dem sons and dem brothers di Levites.

When di builders lay di foundation of di Lord temple, dem put di priests for dem clothes with trumpets, and di Levites, Asaph sons, with cymbals, to praise di Lord, according to di way of David, king of Israel.

Dem sing to each other, dey praise and thank di Lord, say, “Because e good, because im faithful love dey forever for Israel.” All di people shout with big shout as dem dey praise di Lord, because dem don lay di foundation of di Lord house.

But plenty of di priests, Levites and heads of papa houses, di old men wey don see di first house, cry with loud voice when dem lay di foundation of dis house before dem eyes. Plenty shout loud for joy,
so di people no fit know di noise of di shout of joy from di noise of di people crying, because di people shout with loud shout and di noise reach far.
Now when di enemies of Judah and Benjamin hear say di pikin dem of di prisoner land dey build temple for di Lord, di God of Israel,

dem come near Zerubbabel and di heads of di papa houses and talk to dem say, “Make we build with una, because we dey look for una God like una, and we don dey make sacrifice to am since di days of Esar Haddon, king of Assyria, wey bring us come here.”

But Zerubbabel, Jeshua and di rest of di heads of di papa houses of Israel talk to dem say, “No be you and us go build house for our God. Na only we ourselves go build am for di Lord, di God of Israel, as King Cyrus, king of Persia, don command us.”
Den di people of di land weaken di hands of di people of Judah and trouble dem for di building,
and dem hire advisers against dem to spoil dem plan, all di days of Cyrus, king of Persia, even until di rule of Darius, king of Persia.
For di rule of Ahasuerus, for di start of im rule, dem write complaint against di people wey dey stay for Judah and Jerusalem.
For di days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel and di rest of dem group write to Artaxerxes, king of Persia. Dem write di letter for Aramaic language and translate am.
Rehum di commander and Shimshai di secretary write letter against Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes like dis:

Rehum di commander, Shimshai di secretary and di rest of dem group, di Dinaites, di Apharsathchites, di Tarpelites, di Apharsites, di Archevites, di Babylonians, di Shushanchites, di Dehaites, di Elamites,
and di rest of di nations wey di great and noble Osnappar bring come and put for di city of Samaria, and di rest wey dey dis side of di River.
Dis na di copy of di letter wey dem send to am: “To King Artaxerxes, your servants, di men dis side of di River:
Make di king know say di Jews wey come up from you don come to us for Jerusalem. Dem dey build di rebel and wicked city, and dem don finish di walls and repair di foundations.
Make di king know now say if dem build dis city and finish di walls, dem no go pay tax, duty or toll, and for di end e go hurt di kings.
Now because we dey eat di palace salt, and e no fit be for us to see di king shame, so we don send tell di king,

so that dem go search di book of di records of your papa dem. Den you go find for di book of di records and know say dis city na rebel city, wey dey hurt kings and provinces, and say dem don dey cause trouble inside am from long time, and na because of dis dem destroy dis city.
We tell di king say if dem build dis city and finish di walls, you no go get share dis side of di River.”
Den di king send answer to Rehum di commander, Shimshai di secretary and di rest of dem group wey dey stay for Samaria and di rest dis side of di River: “Peace.
Di letter wey una send to us dem don read am clear before me.
I give command and dem search, and dem find say dis city don rise up against kings from long time, and say rebellion and trouble don dey inside am.
Mighty kings don rule over Jerusalem too, wey rule all di land dis side of di River, and dem dey pay dem tax, duty and toll.
Now give command make dem stop dis men, so dat dem no go build dis city until I give command.
Take care make una no dey slow for dis matter. Why make harm grow to hurt di kings?”
Den when dem read di copy of King Artaxerxes letter before Rehum, Shimshai di secretary and dem group, dem hurry go Jerusalem to di Jews and make dem stop with force and power.
Den di work of God house wey dey Jerusalem stop, and e stop until di second year of di rule of Darius, king of Persia.
Den di prophets, Haggai di prophet and Zechariah, Iddo pikin, prophesy to di Jews wey dey Judah and Jerusalem. Dem prophesy to dem for di name of di God of Israel.
Den Zerubbabel, Shealtiel pikin, and Jeshua, Jozadak pikin, stand up and begin to build God house wey dey Jerusalem, and di prophets of God dey with dem, dey help dem.
For dat time Tattenai, di governor dis side of di River, Shethar Bozenai and dem group come to dem and talk say, “Who give una permission to build dis house and finish dis wall?”
Den we tell dem di names of di men wey dey build dis building.
But dem God eye dey on di elders of di Jews, and dem no stop dem until di matter reach Darius and dem send answer by letter about am.
Dis na di copy of di letter wey Tattenai, di governor dis side of di River, Shethar Bozenai and im group, di Apharsachites wey dey dis side of di River, send to King Darius.
Dem send letter to am, and dis na wetin dem write inside: “To King Darius, all peace.

Make di king know say we go di province of Judah, to di house of di great God. Dem dey build am with big stones, and dem dey put wood for di walls. Dis work dey go on well and e dey prosper for dem hands.
Den we ask dem elders and talk to dem say, ‘Who give una permission to build dis house and finish dis wall?’
We ask dem dem names too, so dat we go tell you, to write di names of di men wey dey lead dem.
Dis na di answer dem give us: ‘We be servants of di God of heaven and earth, and we dey build di house wey dem build many years ago, wey one great king of Israel build and finish.
But because our papa dem make di God of heaven vex, e give dem into di hand of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, di Chaldean, wey destroy dis house and carry di people go Babylon.
But for di first year of Cyrus, king of Babylon, King Cyrus give command to build dis house of God.

Di gold and silver vessels of God house too, wey Nebuchadnezzar carry from di temple wey dey Jerusalem and bring go di temple for Babylon, King Cyrus take dem out of di temple for Babylon and dem give dem to one man wey im name na Sheshbazzar, wey e don make governor.
E talk to am say, “Take dis vessels, go put dem for di temple wey dey Jerusalem, and make dem build God house for im place.”
Den dis same Sheshbazzar come lay di foundation of God house wey dey Jerusalem. From dat time until now dem still dey build am, and e never finish.’

So now, if e good to di king, make dem search di king treasure house wey dey Babylon, to see if e true say King Cyrus give command to build dis house of God for Jerusalem, and make di king send us wetin e want about dis matter.”
Den King Darius give command, and dem search di house of di records, where dem keep di treasures for Babylon.
For Achmetha, for di palace wey dey di province of Media, dem find one scroll, and dis na wetin dem write inside as record:

For di first year of King Cyrus, King Cyrus give command: About God house for Jerusalem, make dem build di house, di place where dem dey offer sacrifices, and make dem lay im foundation strong. Im height go be 60 cubits and im width 60 cubits,
with three rows of big stones and one row of new wood. Make dem pay di cost from di king house.

Also make dem return di gold and silver vessels of God house, wey Nebuchadnezzar take from di temple wey dey Jerusalem and bring go Babylon, make dem bring dem back to di temple wey dey Jerusalem, each one to im place. You go put dem for God house.
Now Tattenai, governor dis side of di River, Shethar Bozenai and una group, di Apharsachites wey dey dis side of di River, una must stay far from dere.
Leave di work of dis God house alone. Make di governor of di Jews and di elders of di Jews build dis God house for im place.

I give command too about wetin una go do for dis elders of di Jews for di building of dis God house: make dem pay di cost with all care from di king goods, from di tax of di land dis side of di River, so dat dem no go stop.

Wetin dem need, bulls, rams and lambs for burnt offerings to di God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine and oil, according to di word of di priests wey dey Jerusalem, make dem give am to dem every day without fail,
so dat dem go offer sweet-smelling sacrifices to di God of heaven and pray for di life of di king and of im sons.
I give command too say anybody wey change dis word, make dem pull one beam from im house, lift am up and hang am on am, and make dem turn im house to rubbish heap because of dis.

Make di God wey don make im name dey stay there destroy all kings and peoples wey go stretch out dem hand to change dis or to destroy dis God house wey dey Jerusalem. I, Darius, don give command. Make dem do am with all care.
Den Tattenai, di governor dis side of di River, Shethar Bozenai and dem group do am with all care, as King Darius don send.

Di elders of di Jews build and prosper through di prophecy of Haggai di prophet and Zechariah, Iddo pikin. Dem build and finish am, according to di command of di God of Israel and according to di command of Cyrus, Darius and Artaxerxes, king of Persia.
Dem finish dis house for di third day of di month Adar, for di sixth year of King Darius rule.
Di pikin dem of Israel, di priests, di Levites and di rest of di pikin dem of di prisoner land keep di dedication of dis God house with joy,
and for di dedication of dis God house dem offer 100 bulls, 200 rams, 400 lambs, and for sin offering for all Israel, 12 male goats, according to di number of di tribes of Israel.
Dem set di priests for dem groups and di Levites for dem divisions for di service of God wey dey Jerusalem, as dem write am for di book of Moses.
Di pikin dem of di prisoner land keep di Passover for di fourteenth day of di first month.
Because di priests and di Levites don clean dem self together, all of dem clean. Dem kill di Passover lamb for all di pikin dem of di prisoner land, for dem brothers di priests and for dem self.
Di pikin dem of Israel wey don return from di prisoner land, and all wey don separate dem self to dem from di dirty ways of di nations of di land to look for di Lord, di God of Israel, eat,

and dem keep di Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy, because di Lord don make dem happy and don turn di heart of di king of Assyria to dem, to strengthen dem hands for di work of God house, di God of Israel.
Now after dis things, for di rule of Artaxerxes, king of Persia, Ezra, Seraiah pikin, Azariah pikin, Hilkiah pikin,
Shallum pikin, Zadok pikin, Ahitub pikin,
Amariah pikin, Azariah pikin, Meraioth pikin,
Zerahiah pikin, Uzzi pikin, Bukki pikin,
Abishua pikin, Phinehas pikin, Eleazar pikin, Aaron di chief priest pikin,
dis Ezra go up from Babylon. E be teacher wey sabi di law of Moses, wey di Lord, di God of Israel, don give. Di king give am all wetin e ask, because di hand of di Lord im God dey on am.
Some of di pikin dem of Israel, of di priests, di Levites, di singers, di gatekeepers and di temple servants, go up to Jerusalem for di seventh year of King Artaxerxes.
E reach Jerusalem for di fifth month, wey be di seventh year of di king.
Because for di first day of di first month e begin to go up from Babylon, and for di first day of di fifth month e reach Jerusalem, according to di good hand of im God wey dey on am.
Because Ezra don set im heart to look for di law of di Lord and to do am, and to teach rules and laws for Israel.
Now dis na di copy of di letter wey King Artaxerxes give to Ezra di priest, di teacher, di teacher of di words of di commands of di Lord and of im rules for Israel:
“Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra di priest, di teacher of di law of di God of heaven, perfect peace.
I give command say everybody for my kingdom, of di people of Israel and im priests and Levites, wey wan go Jerusalem, make dem go with you.
Because di king and im seven advisers send you to look into matter about Judah and Jerusalem, according to di law of your God wey dey your hand,
and to carry di silver and gold wey di king and im advisers don give freely to di God of Israel, wey im dwelling dey Jerusalem,
with all di silver and gold wey you go find for all di province of Babylon, with di freewill offering of di people and of di priests, wey dem give willingly for di house of dem God wey dey Jerusalem.
So with all care you go use dis money buy bulls, rams, lambs, with dem grain offerings and drink offerings, and offer dem on di altar of di house of your God wey dey Jerusalem.
Wetin good for you and your brothers to do with di rest of di silver and gold, una fit do am according to di will of una God.
Di vessels wey dem give you for di service of di house of your God, deliver dem before di God of Jerusalem.
Di rest of wetin di house of your God need, wey you go need to give, give am from di king treasure house.
I, even I, King Artaxerxes, give command to all di treasurers dis side of di River say wetin Ezra di priest, di teacher of di law of di God of heaven, ask una, make dem do am with all care,
up to 100 talents of silver, 100 measures of wheat, 100 baths of wine, 100 baths of oil, and salt without limit.
Wetin di God of heaven command, make dem do am exactly for di house of di God of heaven, because why make anger dey against di kingdom of di king and im sons?
We tell una too say e no dey allowed to put tax, duty or toll on any of di priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants or servants of dis God house.

You, Ezra, according to di wisdom of your God wey dey your hand, appoint judges and leaders wey go judge all di people dis side of di River, all wey know di laws of your God. Teach am wey no know dem.
Anybody wey no go do di law of your God and di law of di king, make dem judge am quick, whether na death, or to drive am out, or to take im goods, or to put am for prison.”
Blessed be di Lord, di God of our papa dem, wey don put dis kind thing for di king heart, to make di Lord house wey dey Jerusalem beautiful,

and don show me faithful love before di king, im advisers and all di king mighty princes. I get strength according to di hand of di Lord my God wey dey on me, and I gather chief men from Israel to go up with me.
Now dis na di heads of dem papa houses and di family list of dem wey go up with me from Babylon for di rule of King Artaxerxes:
Of di sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of di sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of di sons of David, Hattush.
Of di sons of Shecaniah, of di sons of Parosh, Zechariah, and dem count 150 males with am.
Of di sons of Pahath Moab, Eliehoenai, Zerahiah pikin, and 200 males with am.
Of di sons of Shecaniah, Jahaziel pikin, and 300 males with am.
Of di sons of Adin, Ebed, Jonathan pikin, and 50 males with am.
Of di sons of Elam, Jeshaiah, Athaliah pikin, and 70 males with am.
Of di sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah, Michael pikin, and 80 males with am.
Of di sons of Joab, Obadiah, Jehiel pikin, and 218 males with am.
Of di sons of Shelomith, Josiphiah pikin, and 160 males with am.
Of di sons of Bebai, Zechariah, Bebai pikin, and 28 males with am.
Of di sons of Azgad, Johanan, Hakkatan pikin, and 110 males with am.
Of di sons of Adonikam, di last ones, and dis na dem names: Eliphelet, Jeuel and Shemaiah, and 60 males with dem.
Of di sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud, and 70 males with dem.
I gather dem together by di river wey dey flow go Ahava, and we camp there three days. I look di people and di priests, and I no find any of di sons of Levi dere.
Den I send for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah and Meshullam, chief men, and for Joiarib and Elnathan, wey be teachers.

I send dem go meet Iddo, di chief for di place Casiphia, and I tell dem wetin dem go talk to Iddo and im brothers di temple servants for di place Casiphia, so dat dem go bring ministers to us for di house of our God.
According to di good hand of our God wey dey on us, dem bring us one man wey get sense, of di sons of Mahli, Levi pikin, Israel pikin, and Sherebiah, with im sons and im brothers, 18,
and Hashabiah, and Jeshaiah of di sons of Merari with am, im brothers and dem sons, 20,
and of di temple servants, wey David and di princes don appoint for di service of di Levites, 220 temple servants. Dem call all of dem by name.
Den I announce fast there, by di river Ahava, so dat we go humble ourselves before our God, to ask am for straight way for us, our small pikin dem and all our property.

Because I shame to ask di king for soldiers and horsemen to help us against enemy for di road, because we don tell di king say, “Di hand of our God dey on all wey look for am, for good, but im power and im anger dey against all wey leave am.”
So we fast and beg our God for dis, and e hear us.
Den I set apart 12 of di chiefs of di priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of dem brothers with dem,
and I weigh give dem di silver, di gold and di vessels, di offering for di house of our God, wey di king, im advisers, im princes and all Israel wey dey dere don offer.
I weigh into dem hand 650 talents of silver, silver vessels of 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,
20 gold bowls of 1,000 gold coins, and two vessels of fine shining bronze, as precious as gold.
I talk to dem say, “Una dey holy to di Lord, and di vessels dey holy. Di silver and di gold na freewill offering to di Lord, di God of una papa dem.
Watch and keep dem until una weigh dem before di chiefs of di priests and di Levites and di heads of di papa houses of Israel for Jerusalem, for di rooms of di Lord house.”
So di priests and di Levites receive di weight of di silver, di gold and di vessels to bring dem go Jerusalem to di house of our God.
Den we leave di river Ahava for di twelfth day of di first month to go Jerusalem. Di hand of our God dey on us, and e save us from di hand of di enemy and di traps for di road.
We reach Jerusalem and stay there three days.

For di fourth day dem weigh di silver, di gold and di vessels for di house of our God into di hand of Meremoth, Uriah pikin, di priest, and Eleazar, Phinehas pikin, dey with am, and Jozabad, Jeshua pikin, and Noadiah, Binnui pikin, di Levites, dey with dem,
everything by number and by weight, and dem write all di weight for dat time.

Di pikin dem of di prisoner land, wey don come out from exile, offer burnt offerings to di God of Israel, 12 bulls for all Israel, 96 rams, 77 lambs and 12 male goats for sin offering. All dis na burnt offering to di Lord.
Dem deliver di king orders to di king governors and to di governors dis side of di River, and dem help di people and God house.

Now when dem don do dis things, di princes come near me and talk say, “Di people of Israel, di priests and di Levites no separate dem self from di peoples of di lands, according to dem disgusting ways, even from di Canaanites, di Hittites, di Perizzites, di Jebusites, di Ammonites, di Moabites, di Egyptians and di Amorites.
Because dem don take some of dem daughters for dem self and for dem sons, so di holy family don mix with di peoples of di lands. Yes, di hand of di princes and rulers na di first for dis wrong.”
When I hear dis thing, I tear my cloth and my robe, pull hair from my head and my beard, and sit down shock.
Den everybody wey dey tremble at di words of di God of Israel gather to me because of di wrong of dem wey dem carry go, and I sit down shock until di evening offering.
For di evening offering I stand up from my shame, with my cloth and my robe tear, and I kneel down and spread my hands to di Lord my God,
and I talk say, “My God, I shame and I dey blush to lift my face to you, my God, because our sins don increase over our head and our guilt don grow reach heaven.

From di days of our papa dem we don dey in big guilt until today. Because of our sins, we, our kings and our priests, dem don give us into di hand of di kings of di lands, to sword, to prisoner land, to robbery and to shame of face, as e be today.

Now for small moment grace don show from di Lord our God, to leave us some remain to escape and to give us place to stand for im holy place, so dat our God go give light to our eyes and give us small new life for our slavery.

Because we be slaves, but our God no leave us for our slavery. E don show us faithful love before di kings of Persia, to give us new life, to set up di house of our God, to repair im ruins and to give us wall for Judah and Jerusalem.
Now our God, wetin we go talk after dis? Because we don leave your commands,

wey you command by your servants di prophets, say, ‘Di land wey una dey go to possess na dirty land, because of di dirtiness of di peoples of di lands, because of dem disgusting ways, wey don fill am from one end to di other with dem dirt.

So now no give your daughters to dem sons, and no take dem daughters for your sons, and no look for dem peace or dem good forever, so dat una go be strong, eat di good of di land and leave am as inheritance to una pikin dem forever.’
After all wey don come on us because of our evil deeds and our big guilt, seeing say you, our God, don punish us less than our sins deserve and don give us dis kind remain,
make we break your commands again and join family with di peoples wey dey do dis disgusting things? You no go vex with us until you finish us, so dat no remain go dey, and nobody go escape?
Lord, God of Israel, you dey righteous, because na remain wey escape dey left, as e be today. Look, we dey before you with our guilt, because nobody fit stand before you because of dis.”
